common._comment: precision/device are inherited defaults -- any block below can still override them locally. active_channel/active_waveform are pure selectors used to look up which channel/waveform block to build; they are NOT inherited, just dispatched on.

binary._comment: shape is a call-time input to BinarySource, not a config field. It is derived at runtime from sweep.batch_size and sweep.num_symbols (times modulation.num_bits_per_symbol for the bit count), so it can never disagree with sweep. See runtime_derivations.py: get_binary_source_shape().

constellation._comment: normalize/center/points only apply if type were 'custom' -- unused for qam.

awgn._comment: no (noise power) is not a static value -- it's computed per sweep point at runtime from sweep.ebno_db via Sionna's ebnodb2no() helper (using modulation.num_bits_per_symbol). x (the input tensor) is the pipeline's own live mapper output, also never config. See runtime_derivations.py: get_no_for_ebno().

tdl._comment: Single-link model (always one tx, one rx). Call-time inputs batch_size/num_time_steps/sampling_frequency are derived at runtime from sweep.batch_size, waveforms.time.num_time_samples, and waveforms.time.bandwidth. See runtime_derivations.py: get_channel_call_kwargs().

system_level._description: 3GPP TR 38.901 system-level channel models (UMi/UMa/RMa) -- antenna-array and topology based, distinct from TDL's simpler tapped-delay-line model.

rayleigh_block_fading._comment: Multi-link model (supports multiple tx/rx, unlike TDL). Shares the same call-time inputs as TDL (batch_size/num_time_steps/sampling_frequency, both are ChannelModel subclasses) but NOT the same constructor shape -- kept as a separate block deliberately, not merged with tdl.

time._comment: Channel model is intentionally absent here. TimeChannel(channel_model, ...) takes the already-built channel object (the output of build_channel()) as its first positional argument at runtime -- it's how build_channel() and build_waveform() wire together, not a config value. no (noise power) is likewise computed at runtime, never stored here.

ofdm._comment: Same reasoning as waveforms.time: channel model and no are runtime inputs, not config fields.
